question: What is the address of principal executive offices and ZIP code?
rationale: The cached coverage files were missing for this slug, so I profiled the rules locally on the sampled documents before spending verify budget. The locality-fragment rule was the only broad rule that fired on all 10 sampled docs, and adding the ZIP rule repaired the five cases where locality-only predictions dropped required ZIP or trailing address detail. This two-rule subset preserved the full-pool 10/10 merge accuracy, while reducing summed avg_cost_ratio from 0.004962 to 0.002048; a one-rule drop-test failed on five documents, so I kept the pair.
